en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing four aerial photographs of an industrial waterfront complex surrounded by forested landscape and a river or bay. The images depict a large sawmill or timber-processing facility with stacks of logs floating in the water, factory buildings, chimneys, docks, and nearby rural settlements. Below the photos, bold printed text identifies the company and location: Ankarsviks Ångsågs Aktiebolag in Sundsvall, Sweden.
